repHigh.title: A legendary welcome
repHigh.description: Your name precedes your ship. The crowd at the arrival gates watches you with something between fear and admiration.

c1.label: Pass through discreetly
c1.msg: You pass by. They murmur behind you.

repLow.title: A hostile welcome
repLow.description: Security agents are waiting for you. They have a list. Your name is on it.

c0.label: Cooperate — pay the fine
c0.pay: -{{fine}} cr. They reluctantly let you through.

c2.label: Flee immediately
c2.msg: You leave the way you came. -1 fuel.

laCarcasse.title: Arrival at The Wreckyard
laCarcasse.description: The smell of rusted metal and bootleg fuel. A kid runs toward you. 'You looking for work? I know a guy.'

c1.label: Ignore him
c1.msg: You walk past. He vanishes into the scrap.

portMeridien.title: Arrival at Port Meridian
portMeridien.description: Clean, organized, monitored. A customs agent stamps your pass without looking at you.

lesBasFondsDeVega.title: Arrival at the Bas-Fonds
lesBasFondsDeVega.description: No checkpoint. No questions. Just stares sizing up your resale value.

c0.label: Blend into the crowd
c0.msg: You get in. No one touches you.

c1.label: Look for a contact right away

arcOuestApocalypse.title: Alanossa's territory
arcOuestApocalypse.description: A ship's cannon tracks you from space. Radio: 'Identify yourself. Now.'

c0.label: Identify yourself normally
c0.unknown: You pass inspection. They don't like you but they let you through.

c1.label: Ignore it — keep going straight
c1.safe: They let you through. Total suspicion.

fortKharos.title: Arrival at Fort Kharos
fortKharos.description: Security code required. The guard inspects you head to toe.

c1.label: Present your military credentials (Veteran/Warlord)
c1.msg: A professional welcome. +15 rep, some credits.

lePurgatoire.title: Arrival at Purgatory
lePurgatoire.description: The doors open onto a heavy atmosphere. A former inmate watches you from the back.

c0.label: Enter and observe
c0.msg: You walk in. The mood is heavy but manageable.

c1.label: Greet the old-timers (if you've done time)
c1.msg: +10 rep. The solidarity of the condemned.

emporiumRequiem.title: Arrival at the Emporium
emporiumRequiem.description: Lavish. Artificial. A sales agent hands you a gilded welcome card.

c0.label: Accept the VIP program (500 cr)
c0.msg: -500 cr but premium access. Likely a net gain.

interrogation.title: INTERROGATION
interrogation.description: A white room. A lamp in your eyes. Questions. Lots of questions.

c0.label: Stay silent
c0.success: They give up. You walk out with your reputation intact. +10 rep.
c0.fail: They don't appreciate the silence. -HP. But nothing revealed.

c1.label: Confess everything
c1.msg: -20 rep, -credits. They release you. A little humiliated.

c2.label: Negotiate a way out
c2.success: Your reputation and some credits change hands. You walk out clean.

trafficking.title: An offer you can't refuse
trafficking.description: During the stopover, a man in a dark suit approaches you silently. "I'm told you're carrying... living cargo. I pay well. Very well. {{offer}} credits, cash, no questions asked." Your passenger heard nothing. For now.

c0.label: Sell your passenger (+{{offer}} cr · trafficking)
c0.msg: The man slides over the credits and disappears with his "cargo". +{{offer}} cr. -30 rep. You won't sleep well.

c1.label: Refuse — a passenger isn't cargo
c1.msg: You refuse flat out. The man shrugs and vanishes. +8 rep — someone saw you refuse.
